project_type: FastAPI Python backend + Flutter (Dart) mobile app with Riverpod/Freezed
build_system: Backend: plain Python venv at backend/.venv, no Makefile. Flutter: standard pub/build_runner. Key quirk: Python code MUST use Optional[X]/List[X] from typing, never X|Y union syntax (3.9 compat enforced throughout codebase).
test_framework: Backend: pytest-asyncio with httpx AsyncClient + sqlite in-memory. Tests live in backend/tests/. Flutter: flutter test (widget_test.dart only — very light). No Flutter integration tests.
build_command: Backend: (no separate compile step — FastAPI runs directly). Flutter: flutter pub get
test_command: Backend: cd /Users/testbedmac1/philldevcoder/projects/proofBuy-AI/backend && .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/ -q. Flutter codegen: cd /Users/testbedmac1/philldevcoder/projects/proofBuy-AI/mobile && flutter pub run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs. Flutter static analysis: cd /Users/testbedmac1/philldevcoder/projects/proofBuy-AI/mobile && flutter analyze
verification_instructions: 1. Run backend pytest (all tests must pass). 2. Run flutter pub run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs (zero errors). 3. Run flutter analyze (zero errors). Fix all failures before marking a FEAT complete.
snapshot_or_generated_files: mobile/lib/shared/models/ranked_product.freezed.dart and ranked_product.g.dart are generated by build_runner and must be regenerated after editing ranked_product.dart. mobile/lib/core/networking/repositories_providers.g.dart is generated by riverpod_generator and must be regenerated after editing repositories_providers.dart.
environment_constraints: Do NOT modify backend/.env. Do NOT restart any running server. Do NOT run flutter pub upgrade — use exact versions already in pubspec.yaml. Absolute worktree root: /Users/testbedmac1/philldevcoder/projects/proofBuy-AI
contribution_requirements: All backend Python must use Optional[X], List[X] from typing (never X|Y). All Flutter text must use pjs() helper from mobile/lib/app/theme.dart — never hardcoded TextStyle with fontFamily. Use ProofBuyColors constants from theme.dart for colors. Never truncate text on the details screen. Run build_runner after every Freezed/Riverpod change.
key_patterns: Backend: NormalizedProduct Pydantic model in app/schemas/product.py; Channel3Service._normalize() in app/services/channel3_service.py converts raw Channel3 API dicts to NormalizedProduct; backward-compat module-level search_products() in channel3_service.py returns plain dicts to the products router. Flutter: Freezed models in mobile/lib/shared/models/; repositories in mobile/lib/core/networking/ all take a Dio parameter from apiClientProvider; riverpod_annotation @riverpod for providers in repositories_providers.dart; ProductDetailsShimmer already exists in shimmer_widgets.dart; existing product_details_screen.dart uses ConsumerWidget, GoRouter extra, and selectedProductProvider fallback; image shimmer placeholder is ProofShimmer wrapping ShimmerBox.
directory_structure: backend/app/schemas/ — Pydantic models; backend/app/services/ — Channel3Service + AI service; backend/app/routers/ — FastAPI route handlers (products, shopping, checkout, transactions, health, auth); backend/tests/ — pytest tests; mobile/lib/app/ — theme + router; mobile/lib/core/networking/ — Dio repositories + providers; mobile/lib/core/widgets/ — shimmer_widgets.dart + other shared widgets; mobile/lib/features/product_details/ — screen + provider; mobile/lib/features/product_comparison/ — ConstraintBadge widget; mobile/lib/shared/models/ — Freezed models
